pr_body:
This pull request does:
- download opus (webm files) as ogg. close #2542 close #938
- recover expired downloads, resolve #2451 fix #345
- show a proper description on the error reporter when a download fails
- possible fix for #2640 (cut-off audio in m4a). fixes #2111
- possible fixes for #2634 and #2429
- calculate eta

required:
- [x] NPE change (https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipeExtractor/pull/199)
- [x] seeking is not available in webm (regresion from #2149) fixes #2676

[ ✔ ] I carefully read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) and agree to them.

Ogg Vorbis streams, if present, should certainly have the .ogg (or .oga) extension.

issue_context.title: Allow resume of download
issue_context.body:
Hey,
I tried downloading a video but didn't finish the download (about 30% downloaded). When I tried to resume the download a few days later it said "Error" in the download (probably cause some link expired). It would be awesome to be able to resume the download but apparently it just overwrites the already-downloaded file with the new one.

Thanks.
comments: Hm the problem with youtube is that stream urls expire, so i cant help there.
But maybe it is possible to save the Youtube url and renew the link and resume the download.
@theScrabi You still think the same? I am not a developer but the idea of ​​updating the link seems simple. I have a slow connection and it drops a lot and this feature would be extremely useful
This could be implemented, but will probably be done after we get rid of GigaGet.
